_README.source: Fixed based on official docs at docs.ltx.video/open-source-model/integration-tools/ltx-2-comfy-ui-nodes
_README.root_cause_of_color_degradation: Audio CFG was 7.0 — official docs warn high values BREAK generation. Combined with no latent normalization, latents drift into oversaturation causing overbaked/crushed colors.
changes: NODE 4: Negative prompt — was empty string, now has proper quality negative terms
NODE 10 (Audio GuiderParameters): cfg 7.0 -> 3.0, stg 1.0 -> 0.5, rescale 0.7 -> 0.7, modality_scale 3.0 -> 1.0, skip_step 0 -> 1 (official baseline: modality_scale=1, skip_step=1)
NODE 11 (Video GuiderParameters): cfg 3.0 stays, stg 1.0 -> 0.5, modality_scale 3.0 -> 1.0, skip_step 0 -> 0 (video processes every step for quality)
NODE 13 (LTXVScheduler): steps 15 -> 8, max_shift 2.05 -> 1.0, base_shift 0.95 -> 0.5, stretch true -> false — distilled model requires exactly 8 steps with this sigma schedule
NODE 20 (VHS_VideoCombine): pix_fmt yuv420p -> yuv444p — prevents TV/limited color range (RGB 16-235 instead of 0-255)
NODE 16: kept as SamplerCustomAdvanced — LTXVNormalizingSampler requires extra inputs (sampler, video_normalization_factors, audio_normalization_factors) not available in this pipeline

_meta.title: Load Gemma-3 12B Text Encoder — device changed to cpu for 24GB VRAM. See Dockerfile for encoder path fix.

inputs.text: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted, watermarks, low contrast, washed out colors, desaturated, overexposed, color banding, artifacts, noise, overbaked, oversaturated

_meta.title: Negative Prompt — FIXED: was empty string. Empty negative = no anchor for color/quality guidance.

Audio Guider Parameters — FIXED: cfg 7.0->3.0 (7.0 BREAKS generation per official docs), stg 1.0->0.5, modality_scale 3.0->1.0 (official baseline), skip_step 0->1 (official baseline = performance + stability)
Video Guider Parameters — FIXED: stg 1.0->0.5, modality_scale 3.0->1.0 (official baseline). skip_step stays 0 for video (process every step for visual quality).

LTX-V Scheduler — FIXED: steps 15->8, max_shift 2.05->1.0, base_shift 0.95->0.5, stretch false. Official docs confirm distilled model requires 8-step schedule. LTXVNormalizingSampler below also only works with 8-step distilled schedule.
Decode Video (Tiled VAE) — kept original values. Change tile_size to 256/overlap 32 if you see seam artifacts.
Save Video + Audio — FIXED: pix_fmt yuv420p->yuv444p (yuv420p uses TV/limited RGB 16-235 range, crushing black point and white point = washed out output). crf 19->18.
